title: PrismWAM
publication_status: Related paper/report verified; release-specific claims supported separately by pinned code
display_citation: PrismWAM: Decoupling State Representations in World Action Models
summary_en: Separates observed RGB history from generated future depth and imagery. Explicit observation buffers survive across calls while temporary model caches are cleared.

analysis_zh: 最有价值的补充是把“过去的证据”和“未来的展开”分别编码：长视频或 WAM 的多帧输入未必都是记忆，但这里的 RGB history 是过去观测。dense 窗口与首帧锚点体现两种遗忘规则；应分别评测短期运动上下文和早期线索保留，不能仅由总体成功率推断 memory 因果收益。
